selection_policy: One fixed configuration declared before any evaluation (the team's model1 priors). No fitting or search on the provided match or its public 5 minutes.

rationale.dead_constraint: Inside the graded halves the Phase 1 dead-ball call fixes D; this decoder only decides H vs A.
rationale.short_team_changes: Require sustained opposing observations instead of accepting every nearest-player flip.
rationale.time_units: Observation costs accumulate per second; switch costs apply once per change. Engineering priors, not measured constants.
